name: superboard
description: SuperBoard multi-application back-office, Cloudflare Workers platform, Flutter SDK, and short links.

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run --filter {./packages/*} check
scripts.worker:check: pnpm run worker:types:reference && pnpm run worker:typecheck && pnpm run worker:test && pnpm run cloudflare:test:services && node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service api --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.billing:typecheck: cd workers/billing && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.runtime.json
scripts.billing:test:runtime: SUPERBOARD_TARGET= SUPERBOARD_ENVIRONMENT= OPENGROW_TARGET= OPENGROW_ENVIRONMENT= node scripts/cloudflare-config.mjs --service billing --reference --allow-unprovisioned && pnpm --dir workers/billing exec vitest run --config vitest.runtime.config.ts
scripts.billing:test: pnpm run billing:test:unit && pnpm run billing:test:runtime && pnpm run billing:test:config
scripts.billing:types: pnpm run cloudflare:config:billing:reference && node scripts/cloudflare-types.mjs --service billing --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.billing:check: pnpm run billing:types && pnpm run billing:typecheck && pnpm run billing:test && node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service billing --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.legacy-messaging:typecheck: cd workers/messaging && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.runtime.json
scripts.legacy-messaging:test: pnpm run legacy-messaging:test:unit && pnpm run legacy-messaging:test:runtime
scripts.legacy-messaging:check: pnpm run legacy-messaging:typecheck && pnpm run legacy-messaging:test && node scripts/cloudflare-legacy-messaging-check.mjs --mode dry-run
scripts.email:test: pnpm --dir packages/email-transport test && pnpm --dir workers/email test
scripts.email:check: pnpm run email:types && pnpm run email:typecheck && pnpm run email:test && node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service email --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.identity:check: pnpm run identity:types && pnpm run identity:typecheck && pnpm run identity:test && pnpm run identity:build && node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service identity --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.files:check: pnpm run files:types && pnpm run files:typecheck && pnpm run files:test && node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service files --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.observability:check: pnpm run observability:types && pnpm run observability:typecheck && pnpm run observability:test && node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service observability --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.mcp:test: pnpm --dir workers/mcp test && pnpm --dir apps/mcp test
scripts.mcp:check: pnpm run mcp:types && pnpm run mcp:typecheck && pnpm run mcp:test && pnpm run mcp:build && pnpm run mcp:lint && pnpm run mcp:audit && pnpm run mcp:docker:check && node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service mcp --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.analytics:check: pnpm run analytics:types && pnpm run analytics:lint && pnpm run analytics:typecheck && pnpm run analytics:test && node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service analytics --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.flows:check: pnpm run flows:types && pnpm run flows:lint && pnpm run flows:typecheck && pnpm run flows:test && pnpm run flows:cutover:test && node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service flows --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.flows-sdk:check:import: node scripts/sync-flows-upstream.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-flows-basics-v2.mjs --check && node --test scripts/sync-flows-upstream.test.mjs
scripts.flows-sdk:check: pnpm run flows-sdk:check:import && pnpm run flows-sdk:build && pnpm run flows-sdk:typecheck && pnpm run flows-sdk:test
scripts.custom-reference:check: pnpm run custom-reference:typecheck && pnpm run custom-reference:test
scripts.custom-vocostar:check: pnpm run custom-vocostar:typecheck && pnpm run custom-vocostar:test
scripts.modules:lint: for service in app products paywalls dynamic-links support analytics marketing onboardings flows; do pnpm --dir workers/$service run lint --if-present || exit 1; done
scripts.modules:types: for service in app products paywalls dynamic-links support analytics marketing onboardings flows; do node scripts/cloudflare-types.mjs --service $service --reference --allow-disabled --allow-unprovisioned || exit 1; done
scripts.modules:typecheck: for service in app products paywalls dynamic-links support analytics marketing onboardings flows; do pnpm --dir workers/$service run typecheck || exit 1; done
scripts.modules:test: for service in app products paywalls dynamic-links support analytics marketing onboardings flows; do pnpm --dir workers/$service test || exit 1; done
scripts.modules:dry-run: for service in app products paywalls dynamic-links support analytics marketing onboardings flows; do node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service $service --reference --allow-disabled --allow-unprovisioned || exit 1; done
scripts.modules:check: pnpm run cloudflare:test:services && pnpm run modules:lint && pnpm run modules:types && pnpm run modules:typecheck && pnpm run modules:test && pnpm run modules:dry-run
scripts.support:parity:check: node scripts/support-parity-check.mjs && node scripts/support-public-leak-check.mjs && node --test scripts/support-parity-check.test.mjs
scripts.support:dashboard:check: pnpm run support:dashboard:test && pnpm run support:dashboard:build && node scripts/support-public-leak-check.mjs
scripts.support:contracts:test: pnpm exec vitest run packages/contracts/src/support.test.ts packages/contracts/src/support-notifications.test.ts packages/contracts/src/email.test.ts && pnpm exec vitest run --config workers/api/vitest.config.ts workers/api/src/lib/support-gateway.test.ts workers/api/src/routes/push-support.test.ts && cd workers/email && pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/inbound.test.ts
scripts.support:types: pnpm --dir workers/support run types && node scripts/cloudflare-types-reference.mjs --reference --check
scripts.support:check: pnpm run support:parity:check && pnpm run support:types && pnpm --dir workers/support run lint && pnpm --dir workers/support run typecheck && pnpm --dir workers/support test && pnpm run support:contracts:test && pnpm run support:dashboard:check && node --test scripts/cloudflare-services.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-bootstrap.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-target.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-secret-inventory.test.mjs scripts/platform-readiness.test.mjs && node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service support --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.support-sdk:check: pnpm run javascript:check && cd sdks/flutter && flutter analyze && flutter test && cd ../flutterflow && flutter analyze && flutter test && cd ../.. && pnpm run flutterflow-library:check && pnpm run flutterflow-applications:check && pnpm run flutterflow-messaging:check && pnpm run support:parity:check
scripts.flutter-purchases:check: node --test scripts/flutter-android-build-contract.test.mjs scripts/flutter-ios-embedded-sources.test.mjs && cd sdks/flutter && flutter analyze && flutter test
scripts.flutterflow-purchases:check: cd sdks/flutterflow && flutter analyze && flutter test
scripts.flutterflow-messaging:check: cd sdks/flutterflow_messaging && flutter analyze && flutter test
scripts.flutter:check: pnpm run flutter-purchases:check && pnpm run flutterflow-purchases:check && pnpm run flutterflow-messaging:check
scripts.react-native:check: pnpm run react-native:native-contract:check && pnpm --dir sdks/react-native run check
scripts.portable-sdks:check: pnpm run javascript:check && pnpm run react-native:check
scripts.identity-sdks:typecheck: pnpm run identity-sdks:build && for sdk in web react vue angular nextjs; do pnpm --dir sdks/identity/$sdk run type:check || exit 1; done
scripts.identity-sdks:test: for sdk in web react vue angular nextjs; do pnpm --dir sdks/identity/$sdk run test:check || exit 1; done
scripts.identity-sdks:build: for sdk in web react vue angular nextjs; do pnpm --dir sdks/identity/$sdk run build || exit 1; done
scripts.identity-sdks:check: pnpm run identity-sdks:typecheck && pnpm run identity-sdks:test
scripts.cloudflare:test:targets: node --test scripts/backoffice-policy.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-bootstrap.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-worker-shells.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-development-secrets.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-target.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-types-reference.test.mjs scripts/superboard-environment.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-deploy-plan.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-site-preview.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-domain-plan.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-migration-batch.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-services.test.mjs scripts/configuration-boundaries.test.mjs scripts/custom-worker-check.test.mjs scripts/github-bootstrap.test.mjs scripts/github-deployment-matrix.test.mjs scripts/github-deployment-workflow.test.mjs scripts/github-history-plan.test.mjs scripts/github-readiness.test.mjs scripts/github-reconcile.test.mjs scripts/non-node-security-audit.test.mjs scripts/superboard-configure-application.test.mjs scripts/superboard-generate-identity-keyset.test.mjs scripts/superboard-generate-melody-auth-secrets.test.mjs scripts/superboard-target-options.test.mjs scripts/platform-readiness.test.mjs scripts/public-routing-gate.test.mjs scripts/site-release-workflow-schema.test.mjs scripts/vocostar-managed-workers.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-d1-*.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-flows-version-bundle.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-secret-bundle.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-secret-promote.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-secret-retire.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-secret-inventory.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-secret-preflight.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-rotate-oauth.test.mjs
scripts.secrets:scan: pnpm run secrets:scan:history && pnpm run secrets:scan:workspace
scripts.emdash:parity:check: pnpm --filter @superboard/supbrd-core build && node scripts/emdash-parity-matrix.mjs && node --test scripts/emdash-parity-matrix.test.mjs scripts/dashboard-route-parity.test.mjs
scripts.site:check: pnpm run --filter @superboard/site... build && pnpm run site:types && pnpm run site:typecheck && pnpm run site:test && pnpm run site:dry-run
scripts.superboard:typecheck: pnpm run worker:typecheck && pnpm run billing:typecheck && pnpm run email:typecheck && pnpm run identity:typecheck && pnpm run files:typecheck && pnpm run observability:typecheck && pnpm run mcp:typecheck && pnpm run modules:typecheck && pnpm run dashboard:typecheck && pnpm run site:typecheck
scripts.superboard:test: pnpm run contracts:test && pnpm run dashboard:test && pnpm run worker:test && pnpm run billing:test && pnpm run email:test && pnpm run identity:test && pnpm run files:test && pnpm run observability:test && pnpm run mcp:test && pnpm run modules:test && pnpm run site:test
scripts.test:e2e:real: cd apps/dashboard && PLAYWRIGHT_REAL_BACKEND=1 pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:all: pnpm run brand:check && pnpm run copy:check && pnpm run sdk:catalog:check && pnpm run sdk:catalog:test && pnpm run sdk:documentation:check && pnpm run flows-sdk:check && pnpm run flutterflow:source:test && pnpm run flutterflow-library:check && pnpm run flutterflow-applications:check && pnpm run migration:inventory && pnpm run migration:inventory:test && pnpm run cloudflare:test:targets && pnpm run dashboard:lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run site:check && pnpm run custom:check:all && pnpm run legacy-messaging:check && pnpm run chatwoot:test && pnpm run flutter:check && pnpm run portable-sdks:check && pnpm run identity-sdks:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run module-cutover:test && pnpm run dashboard:cf-build:reference && pnpm run worker:check && pnpm run identity:check && pnpm run files:check && pnpm run observability:check && pnpm run mcp:check && pnpm run modules:check
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run emdash:typecheck && pnpm run superboard:typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run emdash:test && pnpm run superboard:test
